# Winstanley & Son

> Winstanley & Son Opticians: independent eyecare and bespoke handmade eyewear at 252 Park Road, Dingle, Liverpool L8 4UE, since 1998. Varifocal specialists. The only bespoke frame makers in Merseyside. 5.0 stars from 210 Google reviews.

- Phone 0151 726 0622. Email help@winstanleyandson.co.uk. Book online: https://api.leadconnectorhq.com/widget/booking/4sJKbS06FGilvKy4Kjwy
- Services: varifocal fitting (ready in 48 hours), private and NHS eye examinations, same day single vision glasses from stock lenses, bespoke frames cut by hand from Italian Mazzucchelli acetate in two to three weeks with a three-year guarantee, repairs, 0% finance over six months.
- Lenses: Essilor, Nikon, Zeiss, Hoya. Varifocals measured with the Essilor Visioffice digital measuring system, never a felt-tip pen. Frames: Tom Ford, Giorgio Armani, Ray-Ban and our own handmade frames.
- Open Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, closed weekends. Free parking outside and at Tesco Extra opposite.
